verdict.rationale: New Relic is an observability SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party docs announce an official MCP server that connects AI development tools to New Relic platform context and converts plain-English questions into NRQL, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. The evidence is limited to a single what's-new announcement, so setup, auth and the full tool surface are thin. Missing for 10: detailed setup/authentication docs, an enumerated tool/capability list, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working with agents.
